description: This file defines an interface `JsonWebToken` representing a JSON Web Token (JWT), including methods to access token components like header, body, signature, claims, and expiration status. It also contains a nested static class `JsonFields` that defines constants for JWT claim field names.

classes.name: JsonWebToken
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for a JSON Web Token, including methods to retrieve token components, claims, and expiration status.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the encoded token as a string.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the JSON object representing the token's header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the JSON object representing the token's body.

methods.name: getKeyId
methods.description: Returns the key identifier associated with the token.

methods.name: getIssuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer of the token.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature string of the token.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns a list of subject claims (e.g., user identifiers) associated with the token.

methods.name: getAudience
methods.description: Returns the audience claim of the token.

methods.name: getAuthorizedParty
methods.description: Returns the authorized party claim of the token.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Returns a list of scope claims of the token.

methods.name: getExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns the expiration time as an Instant object.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Returns true if the token is expired, false otherwise.
